mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 1.5% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.0% signals labor market deterioration and recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of UNRATE > 4.0% instances, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates economic contraction, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction's Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising) increase discount rates for equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of tightening cycle instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1) reflects robust economic activity, increasing corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive in high GDPC1 growth periods (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units indicate weak consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of HOUST < 1200 instances, or the signal's Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS) coupled with low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) indicates consumer strength under accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals full employment and imminent rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of late-cycle expansion instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.
